response.rationale: R3 (Septic Arthritis) is the champion due to the presence of knee pain, swelling, and elevated inflammatory markers, although the absence of fever and unremarkable radiograph are counterfactuals. C1 (Methotrexate-induced rheumatologic reaction, acute) is the runner-up due to the temporal relationship between methotrexate administration and symptom onset.
